page.layout: One page, all text centred in one column: title block from top to bottom, then the printer's device (fleuron), a rule, and the printer's imprint line at the foot. No margin text. Library stamp, handwritten shelf mark and show-through from the reverse are excluded.

main_text.l: ad diem 28 & 29 Septemb. An. M. DC. XCIV.

page.notes: Printer's device (decorative fleuron) between "Basileenses." and "BASILEÆ", not text. Ornamental rule above the imprint line, not text. The library ownership stamp at top left, the handwritten "Diss. 446, N°10." at top left, and the round library stamp "UNIVERSITÄTS-BIBLIOTHEK BASEL" overlapping the imprint line are excluded. The imprint line is partly covered by that stamp: "JACOBUS W" and "ERENFELSIUS" are legible, the letters between are read as "JACOBUS WERENFELSIUS". "JOA;CHIMUS" is marked uncertain: the colon-like mark between JOA and CHIMUS may be a printed punctuation or a ligature. "DEO Favente" has a printed hook after "Favente", a ligature/abbreviation mark, not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse (faint lines of Latin text along the right and left margins and the lower half) is excluded.
